question: Should WebChat gain a first-class user-defined shortcut/snippet surface, and should that surface be core-owned config/state or a plugin/skill Control UI API?
rationale: The request aligns with WebChat ergonomics, but current WebChat intentionally has no persisted config section and VISION.md prefers optional capabilities to live in plugins or plugin API extensions when possible.

options.title: Design plugin/API-first shortcuts
options.body: Add or approve a generic shortcut metadata plus composer insertion API so skills/plugins can provide snippets without creating a one-off WebChat config surface.

options.title: Build a core WebChat snippet panel
options.body: Accept the new core product surface and define storage, migration, docs, and UI behavior for user-managed snippets directly in WebChat.

options.title: Rely on existing command discovery
options.body: Close or defer this feature and continue using slash-command discovery, skill commands, and the command palette as the supported discoverability paths.

recommendation.title: Design plugin/API-first shortcuts
recommendation.body: Add or approve a generic shortcut metadata plus composer insertion API so skills/plugins can provide snippets without creating a one-off WebChat config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties steipete to WebChat config removal, sidebar/command-palette direction, and product-level UI decisions for this surface.
